enumeration_note: Single trade narrated live but with a runnable taught entry (rejection off 50 MA, bar close under 25 EMA with confirmation, short into channel break) plus BE-stop and measured-move exit; one strategy, no compatible variants.

coaching_notes: i gave enough time i don't want to wait too long
sometimes if you don't see that move in time then usually price goes back up
element_inventory: PRECONDITION: down channel forming with expectation of a channel break and continued move down
PRECONDITION: bulls reject from the 50 moving average line with a weak close
ENTRY: short when a bar closes under the blue 25 exponential moving average line
ENTRY CONFIRMATION: wait for confirmation on that bar closing under the 25 EMA before entering
SCALING: add a second contract on a pullback
STOP: move stop to break even once price has had time to move away from entry
INVALIDATION: kill the trade if price closes above the 25 EMA (channel would break up)
TARGET: measured move â€” expect the second down-leg to be about the same size as the first move; exit at the bottom level
TIME GATE: price must break down soon after entry, otherwise it tends to go sideways or back up
strategies.entry_summary: In a down channel where bulls fail to push up off the 50 moving average and print a weak/rejection close, wait for a bar to close under the blue 25 exponential moving average with confirmation on that bar, then enter short anticipating a channel break to the downside. A second contract is added on a pullback.
strategies.exit_summary: Move stop to break even after giving the trade enough time to move away from entry; if price closes back above the 25 EMA, kill the trade. Target a measured move roughly equal to the size of the first down-leg, exiting at the bottom level.
strategies.name: channel_break_25ema_short
